items.title: Crypto rises with Asian tech stocks, zcash extends gain after setting upgrade date
items.summary: Bitcoin rose to a one-week high as Asian tech stocks rebounded and SpaceX and Tesla formed committees to explore a merger.

items.title: Zcash developers confirm November date for upgrade that triples payment speed
items.summary: The NU7 upgrade will cut the time between Zcash blocks to 25 seconds from 75 seconds. The chosen block height still has to be merged into the spec and shipped in node software.

items.title: Bitcoin hovers around $83,000 as AI earnings revive tech, ZEC jumps 11%
items.summary: Strong results from SpaceX and Super Micro sent Asian chip stocks surging, and ZEC led crypto higher after developers set a date for its next network upgrade.

items.title: Bitcoin risk management grows more popular as the 'just bet on price' era fades
items.summary: Your day-ahead look for Oct. 21, 2026

items.title: Monero futures are again heating with leverage, raising volatility risks
items.summary: Open interest has topped $300 million and price is back above $600. A similar setup was seen before January's crash.

items.title: Ripple brings Wall Street into 24/7 stock bets, but HSBC warns markets are still thin
items.summary: Institutions can trade through Ripple Prime and post RLUSD as collateral. Finding enough buyers and sellers for large positions could prove harder.

items.title: SequenceHash: multihashing for the rest of us
items.summary: Multihashing is one of those cryptographic tasks that’s easy not to think about too much. This is unfortunate, because multihashing is a common stumbling point when cryptographers try to use hashes. As part of our goal to “fix software, not bugs,” Trail of Bits is introducing Seq

items.title: Why centralized exchanges refuse to list legacy crypto tokens without explicit SEC immunity
items.summary: Vault12 raised $17.45 million selling VGT in 2018 and says it met or dropped every promise, yet the token has never traded on a centralized exchange.

items.title: Japanese visitors may be able to pay with yen stablecoins in South Korea under Shinhan-SBI pact
items.summary: The collaboration will explore card-linked merchant payments for Japanese visitors in South Korea and peer-to-peer wallet transfers among broader cross-border trade remittances.

items.title: Dogecoin wallet, app teams unite in push to give DOGE more everyday uses
items.summary: Dogecoin Labs will combine MyDoge, DogeOS and merchant payment tools as developers try to turn coin holders into customers for applications and businesses.

items.title: OCC's final rule to start fresh in weighing stablecoin rewards against GENIUS Act ban
items.summary: The U.S. Office of the Comptroller of the Currency is the first of several federal agencies to finish writing regulations under the act.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin rises above $83,000 as SpaceX results, possible Tesla merger, lift markets
items.summary: South Korea data center player Elice surged 30% after plunging about the same amount following its IPO one day earlier.

items.title: SpaceX and Tesla explore merger that would unite more than 30,000 bitcoin
items.summary: Independent committees are assessing a potential tie-up, while strong SpaceX earnings lift shares ahead of Tesla’s results.

items.title: Tether leads $15 million funding round for AI-focused payment startup Mural
items.summary: The Series A round, which included participation from North Island Ventures and existing investors, brings New York-based Mural's total funding to $28 million.

items.title: Solana’s Alpenglow, its biggest network overhaul since 2020, goes live Wednesday
items.summary: Alpenglow will replace the voting system Solana has used since 2020, targeting roughly 150-millisecond finality after months of testing that included a failed migration and rollback.

items.title: A company that vouches for websites had secret keys so weak that 8 of them were cracked
items.summary: Eight secret keys at eMudhra, an Indian firm that vouches for websites, were compromised. This is a generic, not crypto-specific, risk.

items.title: OCC finalizes GENIUS Act rules for stablecoin issuers and custody
items.summary: The Office of the Comptroller of the Currency’s final rule covers payment stablecoin issuance and some custody activities, with the GENIUS Act framework taking effect in mid-January.

items.title: Standard Chartered signs definitive deal to acquire Zodia Custody
items.summary: The signing follows shareholders’ acceptance of Standard Chartered’s non-binding offer in May, with regulatory approvals still pending.

items.title: PancakeSwap TVL tops $380M as major fee overhaul heads to vote
items.summary: PancakeSwap’s proposed fee-sharing overhaul would give liquidity providers 88% of swap fees and cut CAKE emissions by 69%, as BNB Chain’s DeFi activity expands.

items.title: France proposes liability for crypto exchanges offering DeFi access
items.summary: French authorities want crypto exchanges to conduct checks on DeFi protocols and face liability for certain customer losses under proposed changes to EU crypto rules.
